basicDetails.schemeName: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT

children.text: The applicant should be a student.
The applicant should belong to the NT/DNT (Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes) category.
The applicant should be studying in a self-financed college in Gujarat.
The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination.
The applicant’s individual and family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
The  Institute must be certified by the government.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to Nomadic and De-notified Tribe students for pursuing higher education in self-financed colleges.

children.text: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support students belonging to Nomadic Tribes and De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT) categories in accessing quality education in self-financed colleges by reducing the financial burden. Through this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹50,000/- is provided to cover tuition fees, registration charges, education fees, and other scholarship-related expenses for students enrolled in self-financed colleges. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, and seeks to empower NT/DNT students with improved access to higher education opportunities.

Through this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹50,000/- is provided to cover tuition fees, registration charges, education fees, and other scholarship-related expenses for students enrolled in self-financed colleges.
